newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Best Buy EPS view raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Best Buy EPS view raised.

text.p: --EVEREN Securities Inc on Thursday said it raised its fiscal 1998 earnings estimate on Best Buy Co Inc to $0.45 a share from $0.20. It also established a fiscal 1999 EPS estimate of $0.60.
--Analyst Beth Richard said the fiscal 1998 forecast was increased after the retailer reported stronger-than-expected earnings in the fourth quarter of fiscal 1997, ended March 1.

--The retailer's performance reflected a more favorable merchandise mix as it focused on categories such as major appliances, large-screen televisions and digital satellite systems, which have higher profit margins, she said.
--EVEREN on Wednesday upgraded its investment rating on the stock to market performer from underperform.
-- Best Buy was up 1/4 at 13-1/4 early Thursday afternoon.
